title: Case input: everything known about one scam-campaign instance (Track A output, Track B input)
description: One case = one ad plus the pages and logs behind it. Built by src/ads/preprocess/assemble.py, consumed by src/ads/llm/extract.py, which turns the parts into the labeled sections of prompts/extraction.txt ([AD_CREATIVE], [BRIDGE_PAGE], [OFFER_PAGE], [DECOY_PAGE], [TECHNICAL_SUMMARY], [RESOLVED_IDENTITIES]). All file paths are relative to the repository's data/ directory and use forward slashes.

role.description: Funnel stage this part plays. At most one ad_creative per case; several pages of the same role are allowed (e.g. a multi-step quiz) and are concatenated in the given order.

medium.description: How the part was captured. Only used for preprocessing and for choosing what to send to the model; the extraction output never mentions it.

source_files.description: Original files this part was built from (traceability only; the model never sees them).

text.description: Visible text of a page or message, in its original language, with scripts/styles removed and OS/feed UI excluded. null for pure images and videos (the model OCRs them).

images.description: Images shown to the model: ad screenshots, or the 2x2 contact sheet of a video (contact_sheet.jpg). Screenshots should already be cropped to the sponsored item where possible.

transcript.description: Original-language speech transcript for video parts; null if there is no speech or transcription was not run. Never invented.

notes.description: Free-text hint from the person assembling the case (e.g. 'second page of the quiz'). Not shown to the model.

identity.description: A person shown in the creative whose identity was established OUTSIDE the LLM: by the face-recognition module, by a human annotator, or from a caption. Mirrors the output of src/ads/preprocess/faces.py.

case_id.description: Stable ID, normally the sample folder name (e.g. '48'). Becomes parent_ad_id for generated variants.

technical_summary.description: Output of src/ads/preprocess/har.py (the 'technical_artifacts' object, minus ad_library_metadata, which comes from the creative). Empty arrays when no network log exists.

resolved_identities.description: Identities established outside the LLM. Empty array if none.
